pyq_bad.why: garbled options; question annulled by commission

patterns: APPSC asks Gaganyaan as statement sets (Vyommitra is female, not male; HLVM3 not GSLV Mk II; DRDO support) and 'which names are the Gaganyatris' with Pankaj M. Sinha as the trap.
Event-dated items recur: Leh analogue mission, Human Spaceflight Expo venue/dates, Wentian/Tiangong modules, ISS first module Zarya.
Physics of weightlessness appears as one-liners/A-R (apple released from spaceship, candle flame, mass vs weight).
App relies heavily on 2025-26 test dates (IADT-01/02, SOLVE) and long multi-statement sets; exam keeps to named facts and people.
